reasoning_traces.think:
The comparator operates by mapping a root cause to a set of factor keys using a predefined lookup table. Each pre-mortem bullet is evaluated against this set to determine if its factor key is included. If so, it is tagged CALLED; otherwise, DID_NOT_HAPPEN. The final coverage classification depends on whether at least one bullet was tagged CALLED. This process defines a binary decision boundary over the space of possible root causes and bullet sets. The system enforces mutual exclusivity of tags and prevents mutation of inputs to maintain integrity. Incomplete coverage arises when no bullet matches the mapped factors, while complete coverage requires at least one match. The narrative summaries reflect these outcomes without justification or excuse, preserving objectivity.
